acceptance_predicates.description: After the inherited-fd PTY TUI reaches readiness, the offline default Run Control action is dispatched exactly once and the paired ASB journey completes.
Run Control cannot dispatch before readiness, from stale selection state, or from malformed/unavailable input; those cases fail closed with bounded diagnostics.
The repair preserves inherited file descriptors, PTY interaction, binary/source/tree identity, timeout, cleanup, and no-secret evidence assertions.
The reviewed exact head has signed DCO history, independent review, terminal-success required CI, merge, and post-merge ASB qualification evidence.

definition_of_done: The current asb-tui main passes ASB PR #627's exact inherited-fd/PTY qualification without weakened assertions.
